standard.summary: 训练 batch 中作为源图参考 latent 的字段名。
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

standard_en.summary: The name of the field in the training batch that holds the source image's reference latent.
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

advanced.principle: 训练 batch 中作为源图参考 latent 的字段名。正式配对数据默认 source_latents。

advanced_en.principle: The batch field name used as the source-image reference latent. Properly paired data defaults to source_latents.
